# Neuroscience News

> Neuroscience News is a premier science magazine covering cutting-edge research in brain science, mental health, psychology, and AI applications in neuroscience.

The site aggregates and publishes research articles on neuroscience topics including psychiatric disorders, cognitive neuroscience, and the latest discoveries in brain biology. It serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding how neuroscience research impacts mental health, behavior, and artificial intelligence.

## Key Topics

- Schizophrenia
- Depression
- ADHD
- Cannabis
- Psychedelics
- Mental Health
- Brain Research
- Psychiatric Disorders
- Glymphatic System
- Cortisol
- Grid Cells
- Antidepressants
- Cognitive Neuroscience
- Adolescent Brain
- Hallucinations

## Core Resources

- [Neuroscience News Homepage](https://neurosciencenews.com): Homepage featuring neuroscience research on brain science, mental health, psychology, and AI

## Research Topics

- [Psychology Research](https://neurosciencenews.com/neuroscience-topics/psychology): Psychology research topic hub covering ADHD, depression, schizophrenia, and mental health
